question: Which sectors were emphasised in the Eighth Five-Year Plan for employment generation?

options.text: Animal husbandry, fishery, horticulture and rural industries

solution:
The correct answer is __**Animal husbandry, fishery, horticulture and rural industries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Eighth Five-Year Plan** (1992–1997) of India emphasized employment generation through the development of certain sectors that could absorb large labor forces and provide sustainable livelihoods.
 
• **Animal husbandry** was one of the key sectors highlighted, as it involved rural populations and offered opportunities for self-employment, income generation, and poverty alleviation.
 
• **Fisheries** were another focus area, considering India’s extensive coastline and inland water resources, which have the potential for providing employment and improving food security.
 
• **Horticulture** was promoted to boost agricultural diversification, improve rural livelihoods, and enhance income generation for small and marginal farmers.
 
• **Rural industries**, including small and medium enterprises, were supported to create jobs and spur economic activities in rural areas.
